title: Twist 3 Silver Metallic

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: The Airoh Twist 3 Silver Metallic is purpose-built for off-road riders demanding massive aerobic cooling and roost deflection, delivering lightweight balance and wide-vision goggle accommodation. Featuring a High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan architecture at 1473g, it combines progressive kinetic energy dissipation across ECE 22.06 certifications with an acoustically tuned ~98 dB aero profile. An ultra-breathable, antimicrobial interior liner stabilizes the helmet during aggressive terrain vibration, locked in securely with track-proven Double D-Ring retention.

product_details.description: Entry-level MX with excellent ventilation and replaceable liner.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Designed for dirt/MX riding; Twist 3 features a twist-lock retention system and silver metallic finish. Optimized for Intermediate Oval head shape.

technical_analysis: Features Advanced multi-composite aerodynamic shell geometry engineered for optimal impact absorption and stability paired with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release. The interior utilizes Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the Airoh Twist 3 Silver Metallic: combining Global Certified craftsmanship with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release and Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.
yoast_title: Airoh Twist 3 Silver Metallic: Specs, Real-World Review & Price Guide
yoast_metadesc: In-depth review of the Airoh Twist 3 Silver Metallic. Tested shell weight, ECE/DOT safety rating, noise dB quietness, and fitment guide for Intermediate Oval heads.

introduction: Positioned in Airoh's Dirt / MX lineup, the Twist 3 Silver Metallic brings Italian engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified ECE 22.06 track safety.
story:
The Airoh Twist 3 Silver Metallic represents Airoh's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~98 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking a High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan Dirt / MX helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the Airoh Twist 3 Silver Metallic delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
